info.title: Kling 4.0 Flash
info.description: Generate fast 720p videos from text, a start frame, or visual references, and edit an existing video.

post.summary: Submit a Kling 4.0 Flash video task

text-to-video.summary: Generate video from a text prompt

input.prompt: A paper boat floats through a miniature city at sunset.
The camera slowly pushes in as the lanterns flicker.

reference-image.summary: Guide the video with a reference image

input.prompt: The character in @Image1 walks along a sunlit forest trail.

reference-video.summary: Guide movement with a reference video

input.prompt: Recreate the camera movement from @Video1 in a snowy mountain landscape.

image-subject.summary: Guide a subject with a frontal view and reference views

input.prompt: @Element1 walks through the city square shown in @Image1.

video-edit.summary: Edit a video while retaining its original duration

input.prompt: Replace the background of @Video1 with a snowy mountain landscape while keeping the camera movement.

BearerAuth.description:
All API endpoints require Bearer Token authentication.

Create an API key: sign in to PoYo, open **Dashboard → API Key** at [poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key](https://poyo.ai/dashboard/api-key), and click to create a key.

Add it to the request header:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY
```

callback_url.description: Optional webhook URL for task completion or failure notifications.

input.description: Selects editing when video_url is supplied, reference-to-video when reference images, reference videos, or subjects are supplied, image-to-video when only image_urls is supplied, and text-to-video otherwise. All media URLs must be publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS URLs.

prompt.description: Video instructions containing at least one non-whitespace character. Required in every mode except image-to-video, where it is optional. Reference images, videos, and subjects as @Image1, @Video1, and @Element1 in array order. In editing, the source video is @Video1 and reference videos start at @Video2. Existing @image_1 and @video_1 references remain supported.

duration.description: Output duration in whole seconds. Generation defaults to 5 seconds. In editing, omit this field to retain the source video duration; chargeable output duration is rounded up to whole seconds.

resolution.description: Output video resolution. Flash supports 720p only.

aspect_ratio.description: Output aspect ratio for text and reference modes. Defaults to 16:9. In text-to-video, auto is treated as 16:9; in reference mode, auto adapts to the supplied materials. Do not provide this field in image or editing modes.

reference_image_urls.description: Up to 10 publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS reference images. Reference them as @Image1, @Image2, and so on. In reference mode, these images and the optional starting frame together cannot exceed 10 images. Supported in reference and editing modes.

reference_video_urls.description: Publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS reference videos, each lasting 3-20 seconds. Up to 5 in reference mode, referenced as @Video1, @Video2, and so on; up to 4 in editing mode, referenced as @Video2, @Video3, and so on. All input videos together must not exceed 20 seconds.

image_urls.description: One publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS starting frame. Flash does not accept an ending frame. Without references, selects image-to-video. In reference mode, the starting frame counts toward the 10-image and 15-material limits. Do not provide this field in editing mode.

video_url.description: Publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS source video for editing, lasting 3-20 seconds. Selects editing mode. Supports reference images, reference videos, and subjects; cannot be combined with image_urls or aspect_ratio.

items.description: Provide exactly one of element_input_urls and element_input_video_urls. Subjects use array positions, such as @Element1, and require no names.

element_input_urls.description: Publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS images of this subject: frontal view first, followed by 1-3 additional reference views.

element_input_video_urls.description: Exactly one publicly accessible HTTP or HTTPS subject video lasting 3-8 seconds. At most 3 subjects may use videos.

kling_elements.description: Up to 7 position-based subjects. Use @Element1, @Element2, and so on in the prompt. At most 3 subjects may use videos. Supported in reference and editing modes. In reference mode, starting frames, reference images, reference videos, and subjects combined cannot exceed 15 materials; images inside a subject count as one subject.

code.description:
Business status code. `200` means success; any other value means the request failed. Always check this field: some validation errors return HTTP 200 with `code: 400` in the body.

- `200`: Success
- `400`: Invalid request parameters
- `401`: Missing or invalid API key
- `402`: Insufficient credits
- `403`: Permission denied
- `404`: Resource not found
- `408`: Request timeout
- `429`: Rate limit exceeded
- `500`: Internal server error
- `502`: Upstream service error
- `503`: Service unavailable

See [Error Codes](/api-manual/error-codes) for details.

status.description:
Task status. Always `not_started` right after submission. Use [Query Task Status](/api-manual/task-management/status) or `callback_url` to get later states.

- `not_started`: Queued, waiting to be processed
- `running`: Being generated
- `finished`: Completed; results are in `files` or `output`
- `failed`: Failed; details are in `error_message`
